detail.title: Synthesis of Operational Criteria for Objective Physical Records
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes updated findings on the emergence of objective physical records from quantum states. We formalize the criteria by linking decoherence-induced pointer state stabilization (einselection) with the proliferation of information (Quantum Darwinism) and the scrambling limits imposed by out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOC). We have revised the project notebook to reflect these distinct, yet reinforcing, mechanisms.
